contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (81,992) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, echoed at summary line 4 ('From Line 1 Column A') and line 5 (Subtotal) as 81,992; Schedule A's own printed 'Total Contributions Received' line is BLANK on all four sheets, so the cover cell plus the three filled page subtotals are the anchors
contributions.detail: 62 Schedule A rows over four sheets sum to 81,992.00 EXACTLY = the cover's PROMOTED PER-PERIOD cell, Column A. Page by page against the printed 'Subtotal for this page': p3 17 rows = 14,467 = printed 14,467; p4 17 rows = 32,750 = printed 32,750; p5 17 rows = 4,775 = printed 4,775; p6 11 rows = 30,000, where the filer wrote '30,000' in the AMOUNT cell of the last grid row (band 17) and left the printed 'Subtotal for this page' line BLANK - the arithmetic identifies it as the page subtotal, not a twelfth entry (as an entry it would double the page to 60,000 and break the cover by 30,000). 14,467 + 32,750 + 4,775 + 30,000 = 81,992. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is ENTIRELY BLANK on both lines 1 and 2 - the filer left those cells empty, an honest blank, and nothing was synthesized from it. The cover ladder closes independently: line 3 = 0.00, line 4 = 81,992, line 5 = 81,992, line 6 = 76,291.12, line 7 = 5,700.88, and 81,992 - 76,291.12 = 5,700.88 exactly - note this is a WHOLE-DOLLAR contributions figure over a cents-bearing expenditure figure and the residue lands correctly on line 7, so ADDENDUM E5's rounding-residue case does NOT arise here.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (76,291.12) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Subtotal for this page' on the county SCHEDULE B sheet (p7) and the printed 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES THROUGH 6/16/2018 $76,291.12' at the foot of the filer's own attached ledger (p9), and summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 54 rows on the filer's own typed attached ledger sum to 76,291.12 EXACTLY: p8's 33 rows sum to 46,989.56 and p9's 21 rows to 29,301.56, and 46,989.56 + 29,301.56 = 76,291.12 = the ledger's own printed TOTAL = the county Schedule B sheet's printed 'Subtotal for this page' 76,291.12 = the cover's PROMOTED PER-PERIOD cell, Column A = summary line 6. Column B YTD is blank and is never summed. Neither attached sheet prints a per-sheet subtotal, so the per-page figures above are this transcription's arithmetic and the gate is the ledger's single printed total, which the rows reproduce to the cent.

in_kind_convention: not applicable, and TESTED BOTH WAYS on both sides as ADDENDUM G1 requires: no row on Schedule A is marked in-kind, the summary page prints no in-kind line, and the filer's own expenditure ledger has a Classification column with no in-kind category. Leavitt, page-face office 'County Attorney', party 'Republican'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote the name through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). 9 pages, legacy_colAB: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', not an amendment, signed 6/19/18, clerk stamp JUN 19), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, pp3-6 SCHEDULE A ('Page 1..4 of 4'), p7 the county SCHEDULE B sheet ('Page 1 of 3'), pp8-9 the filer's own attached typed ledger, hand-foliated '2 of 3' and '3 of 3'. All inner sheets are strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates' - a THIRD confirmation this chunk that genuinely 2018-dated stock exists (ADDENDUM G5 left it open), and a different wording from the '2018 County Candidate(s)' sheets used by Hemingway in this same chunk. *** THE COUNTY SCHEDULE B GRID IS EMPTY AND THE SIDE IS STILL 'transcribed'. *** p7 carries nothing but the words 'See Attached list' written across the Provider/Vendor column and the printed subtotal 76,291.12; every expenditure is on the filer's own attached ledger. This is ADDENDUM A2/E5's rule - what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries - so the side is transcribed, NOT 'no-schedule-page' and NOT 'empty-schedule'. *** A NEW SOURCE PROPERTY: A NON-ROW FIGURE WRITTEN INSIDE THE GRID. *** On p6 the filer wrote his page subtotal '30,000' into the AMOUNT cell of the last printed grid row and left the printed 'Subtotal for this page' line blank. It is the mirror image of ADDENDUM F1 trap 5 (a ledger row written BELOW the last rule): here a figure that is NOT a row sits INSIDE the grid, where a band-driven reader would publish it as an entry. Only the arithmetic separates them - the eleven entries already sum to 30,000, and publishing it as a row would put the schedule 30,000 over its own cover. No row was published for it. *** THE ROTATED LANDSCAPE OWN-LEDGER HAS A PURPOSE COLUMN THE COUNTY FORM LACKS. *** pp8-9 are the filer's typed table (Date / Provider/Vendor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount / Classification), rotated 90 degrees in the retained PDF. `purpose` on every expenditure row is that Classification cell, verbatim; one row (Utah Valley Chamber) has it empty and is honestly blank. On the county's own Schedule B there is no Purpose column at all. COLUMN ASSIGNMENT BY CONTENT: on Schedule A this filer routinely runs the donor's street address across the 'Name of Contributor' column and finishes it in the address column, so the name and address fields were assigned by what the cells CONTAIN (ADDENDUM F2/G3), never by position; the amounts are unaffected and the field-shift screen passes. PRIVACY: the county redacted FIVE address cells on the attached expenditure ledger with black bars (Videopeel, International Fee, Straticsnetworks, Blanca Pena, Manychat.com) - that is the document, not a failed read, and expenditure rows carry no address field in any case. Schedule A is UNREDACTED and full street lines are visible; they are reduced to city/state at read time and no street line, box number or phone reaches any field or note. Nine donor rows are honestly blank in donor_state for ADDENDUM E4's fifth reason (a city and usually a zip, but no state); the others carry the state as the filer wrote it ('Ut', 'Utah', 'IL', 'PA', 'TX', 'AZ', 'Nv', 'Fl', 'P.R.'), verbatim and un-normalized. CROSS-CHECK WORTH RECORDING (observation only): this filing's 2018 County Attorney filing fee is 766.57, the identical figure transcribed independently from Chad Grunander's 2018 County Attorney filing in this same chunk - agreement within one office and one cycle, which is what ADDENDUM F5 says such agreement is worth.
